_about: Machine-readable metrics rules for judging a video's early performance. GUIDANCE, NOT LAW: thresholds are rules of thumb, not guarantees; shift them for format, audience and niche, state when you deviate, and treat doubtful claims (listed below) with care.

evergreen.meaning: People SEARCH for it; lasts years. Direct, search-word titles; no intro/outro/branding; start the first item by ~second 4-10.
evergreen.traffic_hint: search should be top-3 source; no search = titles are not searchable [s19]

cash_cow.meaning: Browse/suggested driven, can be 'YouTuber-less' (voiceover) and stays 1-3 years. Curiosity titles, scale, documentary tone.

trend.meaning: Rides a current topic ~1 year; zero-restart when the trend ends unless the channel has lasting content.

hype.meaning: News-driven spike; days to 2-3 weeks (max ~2 months). Never START a channel with it; only add it if the channel already serves that audience.
hype.window_days: 4 videos in 3-4 days; no views in first 4 videos = stop

audience_adjustments.duration_effect: Every +15 minutes of video length ~ -3 to -4 points of avg view % (10 min at 35% ~ 45 min at 25%) [s26-27]
audience_adjustments.min_length_note: Under 8 minutes loses mid-roll ad slots (earnings drop) [s27]

combination_diagnosis.if: CTR high + first30 good + avg low
combination_diagnosis.then: clickbait signal: promise not delivered in body [s28]

combination_diagnosis.if: CTR high + first30 weak + avg recovers later
combination_diagnosis.then: hook is bad: cut/fix the intro [s28]

combination_diagnosis.if: CTR low + first30 and avg high
combination_diagnosis.then: audience too narrow to distribute: fix packaging first [s28]

data_discipline.signal: 30-40 views (~300-500 impressions) = a signal exists [s35]; 0-1 views = technical problem
data_discipline.first_48h: CTR is noisy: no decisions, never change thumbnail/title [s25]
data_discipline.publish_frequency_to_window: daily: 7-10 videos / 1-2 weeks; 2 per week: 4 videos / 2 weeks; 1 per week: 4 videos / 4 weeks
data_discipline.analysis_cadence: daily upload -> channel analysis weekly; 2/week -> every 2 weeks; 1/week -> monthly; tracking daily but no decisions [s3]
data_discipline.reference_video: the video that hits the ratios best, not the most-viewed one [s4,s73]
ninety_day_plan: month 3: decide (decision date set in advance)

decision_flow: 1. Metrics inside ranges (+-10%)? -> CONTINUE, do not touch
3. Distribution signal present (30-40 views)? -> EXTEND the window
4. In the intervention zone (20% below expectation)? -> INTERVENE (one rung of the ladder)
5. Three interventions tried, nothing? -> ABANDON the concept
abandon_rule: at least 3 of 4: most metrics in the abandon zone; interventions failed; window over; problem is the concept. A single metric is never a reason [s38,s67]

retention_actions.intro_drop: remove/shorten the intro; get to item 1 by second ~4 [s43-45]
retention_actions.body_early_drop: return to the audience definition; move the answer forward
retention_actions.outro_drop: cut ending at <=10 s after the last value; end on the strongest moment, no summary/thanks [s46]

title_patterns: known topic + unknown detail (most viral ideas)
gap (withhold the answer) / contradiction / cost (concrete number)
title_rules: never describe the video, leave something to close
finalise BEFORE publishing; never change the title of a video that gets distribution (thumbnail may change)
evergreen: clear, direct, search words; cash cow/trend: curiosity + scale
thumbnail_rules: one subject, max two words, high contrast
keep one thumbnail language for >=5 videos
evergreen shows the searched result; cash cow shows curiosity
packaging.description: [interpretation, not in PDF] put the title's search words in the first lines (esp. evergreen) and repeat the promise

hook_rules.open_loops: 3 in the first 30 s: 1 promise + 2 curiosities, closing at different times [s53]
hook_rules.ask_the_viewer: ask a question; call-to-action in the middle and at the end
hook_rules.no_reconvincing: the viewer already clicked: do not sell the video again, start the answer [s44,s62]

copy: number and place of open loops
copy_doctrine.formula_extraction: take the top 10-15 videos of the reference channel; title / thumbnail / length / intro in separate columns; what repeats in ~9 of 10 is the formula; ask 'how is it built', not 'what is it about' [s49-50]

doubtful_claims_do_not_rely_on: '30% AVD rule is about ad placement' [s27] PDF admits it is observation
'first 60 minutes decide the audience' and notification mechanics [s16]
RPM depends on viewer not category [s8-9]: mechanism plausible, no numbers
'title change stops distribution' [s37]: practical warning only
inconsistencies_in_pdf: Trend/Hype table values vs written percentages do not match exactly; use the table
s45 says 80% of loss is in the body, s47 says most is in the first 30 s
case B (s64) is titled 'targeted intervention' but the decision line says 'abandon - focus on CTR'
